domain.description: Best-guess primary website domain, e.g. example.com. Empty string if unknown.

hq_city.description: Headquarters city. Empty string if unknown.

hq_country.description: Headquarters country. Empty string if unknown.

other_sites.description: Other known offices, plants, or operating sites.

type.description: e.g. office, plant, shared service center

industry.description: Short free-text industry label, e.g. 'District heating utility'.

industry_category.description: Bucket used by the BRIM scoring formula. Pick the closest fit.

revenue_range_eur.description: Best estimate of annual revenue, e.g. '100M-500M EUR'. Empty string if unknown.

sap_status.description: Overall confidence/state of SAP usage. Use 's4hana' only when there is direct evidence of S/4HANA (go-live, case study, job posts naming S/4HANA).

sap_signals.description: Short evidence strings backing the sap_status/module inference, e.g. 'Job post for SAP S/4HANA Basis Consultant, posted 2026-06'.

likely_modules.description: Likely SAP modules in use, e.g. ['S/4HANA', 'FI-CA', 'BRIM SOM'].

brim_components_likely.description: Which BRIM/RAR components this company most plausibly needs or runs.

brim_evidence.description: Quoted snippets or URLs supporting the BRIM/RAR fit assessment.

brim_evidence_flags.description: Booleans feeding the numeric BRIM score. Set true only with real supporting evidence in the source content.

mentions_brim_or_hybris.description: Direct mention of SAP BRIM, Hybris Billing, or Subscription Billing.

mentions_rar.description: Direct mention of SAP RAR / Revenue Accounting and Reporting.

mentions_billing_job_postings.description: Job posts for high-volume billing, convergent invoicing, or a rating engine.

mentions_billing_case_study.description: A case study or press release about a billing/revenue transformation.

strong_subscription_usage_model.description: The business model is clearly subscription- or usage-based at volume.

fit_rationale.description: 2-3 sentence qualitative summary of why (or why not) this company needs SAP BRIM/RAR talent, for a recruiter audience.

recent_events.description: 3-5 recent, relevant events: S/4HANA moves, billing/revenue programmes, e-invoicing, funding, M&A.

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) if known, else empty string.

einvoicing_pressure.description: How much near-term pressure this company faces from e-invoicing mandates (e.g. Belgium B2B Peppol mandate from 1 Jan 2026).

recommended_action.description: One sentence: what should the recruiter do about this account this week?

outreach_angles.description: 3-5 short, specific outreach angles/hooks a recruiter could use, tied to this company's actual signals.
